integrity: Analytic proof with comparison, Neumann semigroup asymptotics, and an explicit Green-resolvent calculation. Numerical checks corroborate only finite-dimensional elliptic identities. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local small-data theorem near prey carrying capacity; one contiguous predator interval; positive diffusivities; equality of predator conversion and mortality; smooth cubic Allee growth. Limits are iterated, not uniform in the shrinking-domain parameter.
title: A finite critical predator-extinction mass in a shrinking exclusion-zone habitat
